provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms)

modules.name: Fully cooperative mode
modules.note: All Objectives are public and must all be fulfilled; at least 1 Character must survive.

steps.text: Board on its basic side (red arrow, top left)
Isolation Room (room-action side down), Repository and Backup Power Supply on their slots
Void Seeders: remove the Contaminated Room from the II tiles
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.10

steps.text: Shuffle the II room tiles facedown, 1 per II slot (box the rest); then the I tiles on the I slots
1 random facedown Underground Exploration token on each unrevealed room; box the rest
Exploration tokens: remove 2 Slime and 2 Silence, add 3 Lair; 1 on each unrevealed room and each Elevator Room
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.10

steps.text: Elevator, Main Gate and Rover in their places
Power tokens: 3 in the section slots, 1 on the Elevator; 1 and 2 blue side up, 3 and 4 red side up
1 CSS token facedown on each CSS slot of the time track; box the extra
Night Stalkers Laboratory board: 5 Egg tokens in the Nest; 3 random Weakness cards, the leftmost revealed
Intruder bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, {n} Adults
Chytrid Laboratory board: 5 Eggs, Germinators in their coloured slots (1 protrusion up), 3 random Chytrid Weakness cards with the leftmost revealed
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.4

steps.text: Queen board: the Chytrid Queen in the middle, the Stinkhorns around it; all Intruder tokens in the bag
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.4

steps.text: Void Seeder Laboratory board: 5 Eggs; remove Solid Bulkheads and Wave of Calm, then 3 random Void Seeder Weakness cards with the leftmost revealed
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.10

steps.text: Intruder bag: 1 Blank and {n} random Void Seeder tokens
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.10

steps.text: Carnomorphs Laboratory board: 8 Eggs; 3 random Adaptation cards facedown, a Shambler, Fleshbeast and Butcher on their Adaptations
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.12

steps.text: Intruder bag: 1 Blank, 2 blue Metagorgers and {n} red Metagorgers
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.12

steps.text: Spare Intruder and Carcass tokens beside the board
Shuffle the red, yellow and green Item decks, Contamination and Serious Wound decks; Crafted Item deck beside the Items, Scanner by Contamination
Shuffle the Night Stalker Event and Attack decks
Shuffle the Chytrid Event and Attack decks
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.4

steps.text: Shuffle the Void Seeder Attack deck and the Lockdown Void Seeder Event deck
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.10

steps.text: Shuffle the Carnomorph Attack deck and the Lockdown Carnomorph Event deck
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.12

steps.text: Computer deck on its slot; reveal the top card (Lock-down: reveal the next, shuffle Lock-down back in)
Beside the board: Fire, Malfunction, Noise, Ammo/Injury and Status markers, Doors, Character Corpses, 2 Combat, 2 Noise and 2 Advantage dice
Also the Spore and Mycelium markers
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.4

steps.text: Alert, Autodestruction and Venting tokens nearby; Time token red (inactive) side up on the 15th (green) space
Deal each player a Help card (numbers 1 to player count; draft order) and the matching Inventory holder, plus Contingency and Reference cards
Use the Chytrid Help cards
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.4

steps.text: After dealing Inventories, swap the Help cards for the Lockdown Void Seeder Help cards
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.10

steps.text: After dealing Inventories, swap the Help cards for the Lockdown Carnomorph Help cards
steps.ref: Nemesis: Lockdown Stretch Goals / Chytrids rulebook (Awaken Realms) p.12

steps.text: Remove Objectives for more players; deal each player 1 Corporate and 1 Personal Objective, secret
Draw 2 Solo/Coop Objectives; keep 1 after the first Encounter
1 Solo/Coop Objective per player, all faceup
Deal each player {n} secret Contingency; 1 facedown on the Active Contingency slot, the rest in the Neutral Pool by the Alert Room
1 Contingency on the Active slot, the rest in the Neutral Pool; then draw 2 from the Neutral Pool
1 Contingency on the Active slot, the rest in the Neutral Pool; reveal 1 of them to everyone
Draft: in player order draw 2 Draft cards, keep 1, shuffle the other back; box the rest
Take your Character board and miniature; shuffle your Action deck left of the board; Starting Item in a Hand slot with full Ammo
Quest Item horizontal side up beside your board (inactive)
Nemesis Survivors start in the Isolation Room, Facility Workers in the Repository
Knowledge token inactive side up on the Laboratory board: slot 1 for Facility Workers, slot 3 for Survivors
Each round draw up to 5 Action cards
At the first Intruder appearance everyone discards 1 Objective facedown
Solo: items per room are halved (round up)
Co-op: a Corpse carried to a working Emergency Room comes back next round
To win you must fulfil your Objective and survive: Isolation Room, CSS pod or the Bunker
Player 1 takes the First Player token
